title: Make AI Explain Anything Like You're 10
topic: explain like I'm 10 prompt simple explanations
description: Add 'like I'm 10', one everyday example and a length limit, and any AI explains things in plain words. Demo recorded in an incognito Claude chat.

parts.text: AI answers too complicated? Add a few words to any question.
Ask: explain inflation. You get a wall of textbook words, and you're still confused.
parts.label: BAD PROMPT

parts.text: The fix: like I'm ten, one everyday example, and keep it short.
Explain inflation like I'm ten. Use ice cream prices, four sentences max, no jargon.
parts.label: GOOD PROMPT

parts.text: Now it clicks in ten seconds: same ice cream, higher price, fewer cones for your money.
parts.label: RESULT

parts.text: Try it on taxes, crypto, or your doctor's notes. Follow Prompt Minute for one AI trick a day.
